title: content_calendar
description: Memory block written by Agent 3.2 (Content Scheduler). The dated, timed, platform-assigned publishing calendar derived from an approved content_plan. Each plan item becomes exactly one calendar slot with a concrete publish date/time (local market timezone), a production due date (publish minus channel lead time), and the resolved per-platform cadence rules that were applied. Read by Layer 4 (production due dates), Layer 5 (when/where to publish), and Layer 6 (slot-level attribution). Reads: content_plan, campaign_registry; optional platform_rules, client_profile. Human gate: calendar review.

best_window_local.description: Preferred local-time window(s) for this platform, e.g. '12:00-14:00, 19:00-21:00'.

max_per_day.description: Max posts/day for this platform; null for always-on paid flights.

min_spacing_hours.description: Minimum hours between two posts on this platform; null when n/a.

lead_time_days.description: Days before publish that Layer 4 needs the asset ready.

source.description: Where this resolved rule came from. 'default' = built-in LATAM SMB defaults; 'platform_rules' = client/agency override.

topic.description: Editorial angle carried through unchanged from content_plan (client-facing, ES-MX).

messaging_pillar.description: Approved messaging pillar carried from the plan item.

target_segment_id.description: Audience segment id carried from the plan item.

trend_ref.description: Trend id/label carried from the plan item; null when evergreen.

slot_type.description: organic_post = social feed post; paid_flight = always-on ad launch slot; send = email/whatsapp send; publish = blog/landing_page go-live.

publish_date.description: Concrete publish date (YYYY-MM-DD) inside the item's week range and the campaign window, on an allowed day, not in a blackout.

publish_time_local.description: Local publish time (HH:MM, 24h) in timezone, inside the platform window and outside quiet hours (07:00-21:30).

timezone.description: IANA timezone the publish_time_local is expressed in, e.g. America/Mexico_City.

production_due_date.description: publish_date minus the channel lead time; the asset deadline for Layer 4.

status.description: scheduled = placed cleanly; shifted = moved off the ideal date to satisfy a constraint (explained in scheduling_notes); blocked = could not be placed.

cta.description: Call-to-action carried through unchanged from the plan (client-facing, ES-MX).

notes_for_creator.description: Optional guidance carried through from the plan item (EN).

created_at.description: ISO 8601 datetime when this content_calendar was generated.

gate_status.description: Calendar review gate status. Must be 'approved' before Layer 4 produces or Layer 5 publishes. 'blocked' = upstream content_plan missing/unapproved or an impossible window/blackout conflict.

cycle_month.description: Marketing cycle this calendar covers, YYYY-MM (carried from content_plan).

cycle_weeks.description: Number of weeks in the cycle (default 4).

timezone_primary.description: Primary IANA timezone used for all publish_time_local values, derived from markets[0] / client_profile.locations.

markets.description: Target markets for this cycle, ordered by priority (carried from content_plan).

cadence_rules.description: The resolved per-platform cadence/timing rules actually applied (defaults overridden by platform_rules where present).

slots.description: Dated, timed, platform-assigned content slots. One per content_plan item. May be empty ONLY when gate_status == 'blocked'.

total_slots.description: Must equal the source content_plan summary.total_items.

scheduling_notes.description: EN - cadence rules applied, dependency ordering, date shifts, unplaceable items, lead-time flags, blocked reasons.
